questions: Does community.vmware share code with vmware.vmware?

answer_card.title: community.vmware major changes (13.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md: community.vmware now **re-uses code from vmware.vmware** and replaced its use of `ansible.module_utils._text`, `ansible.module_utils.common._collections_compat` and `ansible.module_utils.six`.
